scientific_integrity.mathematical_basis: Arbitrary-graph Sherman–Morrison proof and missing-edge incidence eigenvector characterization.
scientific_integrity.proof_status: A complete proof is included; finite checks are supplementary, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: verify.py performs exact symbolic checks for 772 connected labeled graphs and 3,227 missing-edge cases through 5 vertices.

scientific_limitations: Only a homogeneous unit-self-weight Friedkin–Johnsen equilibrium on finite simple unweighted undirected graphs is analyzed.
Only adding one previously missing unit-weight edge with fixed innate opinions is covered.
The theorem is structural and not an empirical social-network prediction.
Original 1990 formulation is historical background; its precise daily public release date was not verified. The date field refers to the selected 2015 public source.
Historical novelty is based on inspected accessible literature; independent scholarly validation has not occurred.
title: False-twin rigidity of polarization under a new social tie
